name: Dreadmaul Rock
summary: Dreadmaul Rock is a towering crag and cave complex rising out of the fiery wastes of the Burning Steppes. It serves as the primary base of operations for the Firegut ogres, who make their home within its winding, subterranean mounds.

sections.title: Stronghold of the Firegut
sections.body: Towering above the scorched plains of the Burning Steppes, Dreadmaul Rock is a massive stone formation carved out by a labyrinthine cave system. Though its name hints at a possible connection to the Dreadmaul ogres of the Blasted Lands, the rock is held firmly by the Firegut clan. These brutish ogres use the elevated paths, crags, and interior earthen mounds as a defended encampment, dominating the surrounding wasteland and menacing anyone attempting to traverse the northern slopes toward Blackrock Spire.

aliases: what ogres are at dreadmaul rock
faq.answer: Dreadmaul Rock is the central base for the Firegut ogres. They inhabit both the exterior cliff paths and the complex cave system buried inside the rock formation.

faq.q: Why is it named Dreadmaul Rock if Firegut ogres live here?
faq.answer: While the Firegut clan currently controls the peak, its name strongly suggests it may have once belonged to the Dreadmaul ogre clan, who maintain a large presence south in the Blasted Lands.

faq.q: What is the layout of the rock like?
faq.answer: Dreadmaul Rock consists of steep exterior ramps winding up the crag alongside an intricate interior cave network filled with ogre mounds and dwellings.
It is located in the Burning Steppes, standing as a prominent mountain-like formation north of the path toward the Redridge Mountains and east of Blackrock Mountain.

angles.text: For Alliance forces guarding the border passes from Redridge, the aggressive ogres of Dreadmaul Rock represent a constant, brutal hazard looming just across the northern ridge.
Horde travelers trekking across the Steppes toward Blackrock Mountain must tread carefully around Dreadmaul Rock to avoid drawing the ire of the territorial Firegut clan.
